quick: All FDA label sections are shown verbatim below

label.Dosage and administration: Temporarily protects and helps relieve chapped or cracked skin.
label.Warnings: For external use only . When using this product keep out of eyes. Rinse with water to remove. Stop use and ask a doctor if the condition worsens or symptoms persist for more than 7 days or clear up and occur again within a few days. Do not use on deep or puncture wounds, animal bites, and serious burns.
